voicelines.transcript: The enemy pales when they see the face of Dazzle!
Take a care when my shadow falls upon the foe.
Where my shadow falls, there falls my foe.
Up to my old tricks again.
My shadow shall darken all creation.
A touch of the old magic.
I convey your spirit to the Nothl realm.
If killing you is wrong, I don't want to be right.
Uh ha ha ha ha ho!
Ho ho ha ha ha ha.
Uh he he he he ha!
Shadow Shaman, over the hills with you!
First Blood! Ha ha ha ha!
Hm hm ha ha ha ha!
I'd set aside funds for this.
Shiva's Guard, to guard us well!
I've been to the place where darkness is light.
Resurrection comes easily to a Shadow Priest!
This death means nothing to me!
I've seen the blinding darkness at the center of all light.
In the Nothl realm, brightness is dark, and the touch that heals a friend will fell a foe.
Ha ha har ha ha ha!
He he he he he he he!
He he he he he he he he he!
The order will have my shadow for this!
